description: Minimal geometric abstract form built from Brad's signature black (#232323) and red (#FF414C) palette. A multi-stop animated gradient breathes between the two brand colors — the highlight diamond pulses red from its tip inward while the solid back-forms receive a faint sympathetic red bleed at their far edges. All geometry is exactly as original. Two independent pulse timings (pulse-a, pulse-b) run offset from each other so the effect feels organic rather than mechanical.

palette_groups.note: Core dark brand tones centered on #232323. Used as gradient stop-color base and solid fills.
Vibrant red brand tones centered on #FF414C. Used in animated stop-color values and bleed overlays.

motion_groups.note: Primary pulse on the highlight diamond gradient — mid-stop color transition and tip opacity breath. Drives the main red transfusion feeling.
Secondary pulse on outer tip stop and solid-shape bleed overlay — intentionally slightly offset in period from pulse-a so the two layers beat independently, creating a natural irregular rhythm.

vars.name: color-main
vars.note: Dark brand anchor. Gradient stop base and solid fill. Canonical #232323.

vars.name: color-accent
vars.note: Red brand accent. Animated into mid and tip gradient stops. Canonical #FF414C.

vars.name: alpha-lo
vars.note: Opacity floor for animated stop-opacity and bleed overlays. The resting 'exhale' state — red nearly invisible.

vars.name: alpha-mid
vars.note: Mid opacity used in the solid-shape bleed gradient tip — a gentler peak than alpha-hi, keeping the solids from overpowering.

vars.name: alpha-hi
vars.note: Opacity ceiling for animated stop-opacity on the highlight diamond tip — the 'inhale' peak where red is most present.

vars.name: alpha-bleed
vars.note: Static base opacity of the solid-shape red-bleed overlay paths. Scales overall bleed intensity independent of animation.

vars.name: pulse-a
vars.note: Primary pulse period (seconds) — drives mid-stop color transition and hi-stop opacity breath on the highlight diamond. Template appends 's'.

vars.name: pulse-b
vars.note: Secondary pulse period (seconds) — drives tip stop color/opacity and solid-bleed animation. Set slightly different from pulse-a for organic feel. Template appends 's'.
